subject: Aurum DPA — questions on residency, retention & deletion
messages:
From: Tom Reeves <t.reeves@aurum.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.menon@aurum.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial: DPA — residency & deletion questions

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Our legal team started a first pass on the DPA and flagged a couple of items we need clarity on before we can move forward with procurement:

- Data residency: we prefer EU-only processing for all customer content. Is that possible on hosted Redwood? Can you confirm which artifacts (logs, backups, telemetry) may leave the region if we choose EU-only?
- Deletion window: we need primary customer data deleted within 30 days of contract termination. What is your current practice for backups / DR snapshots?
- Audit logs & support logs: what retention do you need for security investigations? Can we get an exception carve-out limited to specific circumstances?

I've attached our redline (Aurum_DPA_Redline_v1.pdf) with inline comments. Can your legal/security team suggest concrete replacement language? Also, timeline: we need to finalize the DPA within two weeks to hit our onboarding window.

Appreciate any quick guidance — happy to set up a call.

Thanks,
Tom Reeves
Head of IT Security, Aurum Systems
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reeves <t.reeves@aurum.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: DPA — residency & deletion questions

Hi Tom — thanks for sending this over and for the clear list. High level answers so we can align quickly:

1) Residency options
- Hosted EU-only: we can constrain processing and primary storage to EU regions for the models and customer data you choose.
- Dedicated/Private: for full physical/geographic control we can provision a Dedicated pool or Private VPC (on-prem or VPC) if you need strict isolation.

2) Deletion / backups
- Primary customer data: standard offer is deletion within 30 days following termination or written request.
- Backups/DR snapshots: default is retention for disaster recovery up to 90 days; however, we can propose a shorter backup purge window for commercial customers and contract it (common asks: 30/60/90).

3) Audit/support logs
- We retain control-plane and audit logs for operational/security needs. We can scope log retention and provide a carve-out for legal holds; typical negotiated limits are 6–12 months depending on the data class.

Next steps: I’m looping in Marcus and Neha from legal/security to draft suggested DPA language and propose a compromise backup retention window. I attached a suggested draft to speed review. If it helps, I can schedule a 30-minute call with your counsel later this week to walk through.

Attached: Redwood_DPA_Suggested_vers.docx (highlights on residency + deletion).

Best,
Hannah
B2B Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Initial: DPA — residency & deletion questions

Forwarding Aurum's redline and my quick responses. Key ask: EU-only processing + 30-day deletion for primary data; backup/DR window is their primary negotiation point. Timeline: they want DPA final in ~2 weeks. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4892

Marcus — can you propose exact replacement clauses for: residency (storage/processing boundaries), deletion (primary + backups), and an audit/logs retention carve-out?
Neha — can you confirm technical feasibility for a 30-day primary + 45/60/90 backup options and whether we have anything preventing 45-day destruction?

My read: commercial prefers 30 / 45. Security/legal standard currently: 30 day primary + 90 day backup to allow for DR and forensics. If we move to shorter backup windows we should add an emergency retention carve-out for legal/regulatory subpoenas and a short audit log retention up to 12 months.

Attaching suggested language.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Suggested_vers.docx (attachment)

— Hannah

On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 09:12 AM Tom Reeves <t.reeves@aurum.com> wrote:
> (Aurum_DPA_Redline_v1.pdf attached)
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@aurum.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reeves <t.reeves@aurum.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: DPA — residency & deletion questions

Thanks Hannah — and thanks for the quick reply. A few follow-ups from our counsel after a quick review:

- Deletion: Aurum legal is comfortable with primary data deletion at 30 days but they insist that backups be purged no later than 45 days after termination. 90 days is a blocker for them.
- Residency: EU-only processing for customer content must be contractually guaranteed for all production pipelines. They are OK with telemetry/aggregated usage metrics leaving the EU but not raw logs or any customer content.
- Audit logs: they will accept a carve-out for security investigations limited to instances where Redwood has a legal obligation or a security incident; they asked us to show example language.

We can do a call with counsel — would Thursday 10:00 AM CET work? Attaching a short note with counsel comments: Aurum_Data_clause_comments.txt

Asha
Legal Operations, Aurum Systems
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reeves <t.reeves@aurum.com>, Asha Menon <asha.menon@aurum.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: DPA — residency & deletion questions — proposed path forward

Hi Tom / Asha — thanks for the clarity and for your counsel's notes. Summary & suggested path forward from Redwood: 

1) Residency: we will contractually guarantee EU (EEA) processing and storage for customer content tied to this deal. Telemetry/aggregated metrics will be scoped out explicitly.

2) Deletion: we can accept primary data deletion within 30 days post-termination. For backups/DR snapshots we propose a compromise of 60 days (we understand Aurum asked for 45; our legal/security position is 60 days to preserve ability to recover legitimate DR events and complete forensics). We will include a narrow emergency retention clause allowing retention for legal obligations or active investigations, capped at 12 months and subject to notice to the customer.

3) Audit logs/support logs: we will provide scoped language that limits retention to operational/security purposes and only as long as necessary, recommended default 6 months with the 12-month cap for legal holds.

Next steps: Marcus and Neha will provide the redline text for each clause by tomorrow EOD. I'll set up a 30-minute call with your counsel to walk the language on Friday morning (please confirm availability). Once agreed, we'll issue Redwood_DPA_Final_proposal_v1.pdf via DocuSign (link to follow).

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Final_proposal_v1.pdf (preview of proposed clauses)

Thanks all — looking forward to closing the DPA quickly.

Best,
Hannah
B2B Solutions — Redwood Inference
